verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never describes Cloudflare Sandboxes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. Session-level environment variables, Worker interception of outbound HTTP, and access to KV/R2 bindings are adjacent building blocks, not a credential-issuance capability, so they earn no credit. The axis applies to an agent-execution platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
